_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. cohere.com declares its design layer as Tailwind config utility classes (raw/css-vars.json's utilities bin): a named palette (volcanic, neutral, quartz, coral, mushroom, marble, blue, green, danger, success, onyx, pureBlack/pureWhite), the web3-* type scale, the font stacks, the z/content-width layers and the duration/ease steps. Semantic roles are measured on the painted chrome in raw/components-computed.json and alias the declared ramp when the value matches. One theme exists (light); the footer and promo banner are dark islands inside it.
